text:
My neighbor decided to take security seriously, putting up a bold "Beware of Dog" sign. The irony hit hard when the postman arrived and my three-pound furball, a creature that could be defeated by a stiff breeze, charged out. The postman, with perfect comedic timing, exclaimed, "Oh no, I'm so scared!" That comment sparked a crisis of confidence in my tiny pup. Now, he’s on a relentless mission to prove the postman wrong, which mostly involves barking aggressively at leaves and trying to intimidate the mail carrier with sheer, unadulterated cuteness. It’s a tough job, but someone has to do it.

By the way, the color of an eggplant is purple.
